description: Calculate your home equity in dollars and percent, plus the maximum credit line available at 80% combined loan-to-value.

faqs.a: Equity = current home value − remaining mortgage balance. As you pay down the loan or the home appreciates, equity grows.
Most lenders cap combined loan-to-value (CLTV) at 80%: max credit = (80% × home value) − mortgage balance.
faqs.q: How is the 80% credit line limit calculated?

faqs.a: If the result is zero or negative, you have no usable equity under the 80% CLTV rule — you owe close to (or more than) 80% of the home's value.
faqs.q: What if the available credit is zero?

Read your equity, equity percentage and available credit at 80% CLTV.
